scope: Only three buff CAST source candidates; persistent status assets and previously passed status presentation are excluded and must remain unchanged.
qualityClaim: Source eligibility for focused USB only; not phone or commercial acceptance. No prior non-battle HUD video result is used.

technical.method: Independently decoded each WebP and generation.selectedMother PNG using Pillow/NumPy and compared all RGBA pixels. Frame boundaries use rounded fractional 724/3 row coordinates; four-edge alpha and mass measured.
technical.heightNote: Fractional atlas row height requires current source-row stepping; do not crop/resize source to force divisibility.

reviews.identity: Orange rising fire ribbon, thin ground ring and upward activation arrow preserve rage amplification. Three distinct beneficiary sites; source is visibly a buff rather than a damaging fire-blade barrage. Less arrow clutter than original peak, without loss of upward-power identity.
reviews.sequence: Builds to frame8 strongest arrow/glow, then narrower and dimmer9-12. Peak alpha mass46900, final4883. End remains small rings/flames; verify runtime fade clears them.
phoneChecks: Highest glow is a fairly filled orange envelope: confirm faces and player HP/name remain readable at actual fitted size.
Compare red portrait off/on so cast remains detectable without further source enlargement.
Check frame8-to9 baseline change and release transition for visual jump.
Do not reuse this cast as persistent rage body or change passed status opacity/position.

reviews.identity: Three mint-green wind streams, leaves and low elliptical rings retain evasive wind-flow identity. Lower short ribbons distinguish from upright damaging tornadoes and healing lotus.
reviews.sequence: Frame7 has concentrated ring activation glints;8-12 unwind and fade. Peak mass20211 at7, final3009. Three sites stay horizontally distinct.
phoneChecks: Check ring glints convey activation at7 without obscuring beneficiaries.
Check row2-to3 contraction does not cause perceived floor hop.
Verify small fitted streams remain distinguishable from persistent windwalk state; do not alter passed persistent state.

reviews.identity: Three paired jagged stone guards and golden defensive cracks retain rock-wall protection. Open central gaps replace previous enclosing tall rock domes; enough hard stone silhouette remains to identify earth defense, so smaller height is not by itself identity failure.
reviews.sequence: Grows short protective fins through7, dims/sinks toward localized rubble9-12. Peak mass34657 at7, final5813. No defensive ball is assigned to enemy cast.
phoneChecks: Verify paired guards flank actual allied beneficiaries instead of empty floor.
Ensure peak gold haze does not join into a full-row opaque slab or cover HUD.
Check sinking tail reads as natural cast release rather than flicker; persistent rockWall continues under existing approved status owner.

next: Retain these source candidates and run focused in-battle phone presentation gate. Stop discretionary source refinement absent concrete phone failures; do not change geometry/fit/targets or approved persistent states to accommodate source.
